title: Temperature conversion
description: Converts an exact temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin using the standard formulas (C = K - 273.15, F = C * 9/5 + 32), offline and deterministic. Declines any input colder than absolute zero (-273.15 C, -459.67 F, 0 K), even when the source and target unit are the same. Returns the converted value rounded to 6 decimal places.
when_not_to_use: Weather forecasts or real-world temperature readings, non-SI scales such as Rankine or Reaumur, temperature differences/deltas, heat index or wind chill, and unit conversions that are not temperature.
examples: сколько градусов Фаренгейта в 25 градусах Цельсия?
сколько Кельвинов в абсолютном нуле по Фаренгейту?

value.description: the temperature to convert, expressed in from_unit

from_unit.description: unit of value: Celsius, Fahrenheit or Kelvin

to_unit.description: unit to convert into: Celsius, Fahrenheit or Kelvin

output_description: value (the converted temperature, rounded to 6 decimal places) and unit (the target unit, one of C/F/K).
